method.read: The completed Plain workspace, read-only. No requirement identifier appears anywhere in it, because a Plain codebase carries no citations; every reach is decided by one artifact carrying another's obligation, never by a tag.
method.structural: The seven structural edges were counted twice by independent derivations and agreed exactly, including columnToProperty arrived at column by column.
method.requirementRooted: Each of the six was counted twice, broad and narrow, and the lower rate kept. Both passes used one reach standard — an anchor is reached when an artifact of the target kind carries its central obligation — and differed only in eligibility. Where both returned 1.000 the narrower denominator was kept, because it claims less measured surface for the same rate.
method.populations: 73 requirement anchors, being 19 `##` and 54 `###` headings across the five frozen documents.

eligibilityRules.requirementToModel: The anchor names information, a relationship, or a lifecycle value the database must hold. Request-time rules and read-only operations are outside it.
eligibilityRules.requirementToOperation: The anchor names a user-invocable capability that must be published as one operation. Overviews, domain definitions, and rules enforced inside another operation are outside it.
eligibilityRules.requirementToDto: The anchor defines an operation's request or response payload, or a domain entity's published shape.
eligibilityRules.requirementToTest: Every `###` anchor. The 19 `##` overviews restate their children and are outside it.
eligibilityRules.requirementToScreen: The anchor names a capability or view a user must see or perform in a browser. Overviews, domain-relationship definitions, server-only rules, and non-functional policies are outside it.
eligibilityRules.requirementToJourney: The same population as the screen rule: an anchor a browser journey can walk end to end.

requirementToDto: REQ-RULE-BROWSE-1, whose pagination payload is declared in packages/api/src/typings/IPage.ts rather than in structures; the totals it requires, `records` and `pages`, appear only there
requirementToJourney: REQ-AUTH-MANAGE-2: the recovery journey walks the non-disclosing request and the mode switch, never a delivered proof
REQ-RULE-CREDENTIAL-2: no journey submits an out-of-range password
REQ-RULE-CONTENT-1: no journey submits an over-length title or description; the date rule is walked, the content rule is not
REQ-RULE-BROWSE-4: no journey asserts the omitted-sort default or a tie-break
modelToDto: todo_delivery_effects: no published type carries a recipient, kind, or payload
hookToScreen: useHealth, called only by the layout shell
useRefreshSession, called only by the auth provider in lib
columnToProperty: foreign keys: todo_profiles.todo_user_id, todo_sessions.todo_user_id, todo_todos.todo_user_id, todo_todo_histories.todo_todo_id, todo_recovery_requests.todo_user_id, todo_delivery_effects.todo_user_id
internal lifecycle: todo_sessions.expires_at, todo_sessions.revoked_at, todo_todos.updated_at, todo_todos.content_version, todo_recovery_requests.expires_at, todo_recovery_requests.consumed_at
history change flags: title_changed, description_changed, start_date_changed, due_date_changed

unsettled.screenDefinition: A screen was taken to be a route-rendered page outside components/dev: AuthPage, TodoPage, TrashPage, SettingsPage. Counting the layout shell as a screen would make screenToJourney 5/5 — the same rate — and hookToScreen 23/24 rather than 22/24. The choice is arguable and was not settled on principle.
unsettled.requirementToDto: If packages/api/src/typings counts as published — the SDK does re-export it — pagination is declared and the edge is 31/31 rather than 30/31. The edge definition was applied literally.
unsettled.requirementToTest: The figure is 1.000 under a central-obligation standard. Under a per-clause standard it would be near 47/54: unproven anywhere are the default page size and default sort, registration refusing a malformed email, title and description bounds on edit as opposed to creation, and account deletion removing history entries specifically. The per-clause standard was not used, because applying it to one edge and not the other five would not be a measurement.
unsettled.publishedBounds: ITodo.ICreate.title, ITodo.IUpdate.title, IUser.IJoin.displayName, and IUser.IUpdateProfile.displayName carry a minimum without the maximum their output types carry. The field was judged declared.
